title: Celestin's Tuxedo and Maple Leaf bands, as described by a visitor
summary: A second speaker recalls Celestin's Original Tuxedo and Maple Leaf bands alternating with Piron, and names Tio and Charlie Bocage.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: They used to play, they used to sing with me when he'd come home and how he and Mr. Celestan they used to alternate you know. Celestan had the original Tuxilla and he had the Maple Leaf band. And they used to buck against one another. And from what I can understand it was the only two bands in New Orleans outside of Pierron. I mean Pierron was in a different class altogether. He was in a high society class. And the original Tuxillas and the Maple Leaf they had their class. And sometimes they used to alternate. One time Pierron and the original Tuxillas with me at the New Orleans Country Club. And maybe the next week Pierron and the Maple Leaf band with me. And they used to do me all the good in the world to hear that how you talk about it.
Yeah. We're going to have to find some of the different fellows that used to work with. With the Maple Leafs. Oh yeah. Yeah. Did you know any of the men in the band?

Well I knew Tio, a saxophone player, but I understand he passed. And there's a little banjo player by the name of Charlie. A little Mexico fellow. I don't know what happened to him. I know him. I think Charlie Boccage. Yeah.
His brothers are calling that trumpet player. Uh huh.

Yeah. And I mean they can give you more of it you know. Yeah. Well we just, it helps to know a name you know. Why sure. You get a name, you lead on somebody. Find out what's what. But I knew Tio and Charlie, I mean as I grew up, I mean they got together at one time.
And organized a band. the band well after they organized the man and they pointed out to me the ones that played with him during the time he didn't need for these bands do you play
